name: Meltano Open-Source ELT CLI
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source command-line data integration and ELT orchestration engine for extracting, loading and transforming data using configurable plugins; no Meltano OSS license fee or vendor-imposed local pipeline quota.
watch_out: Self-operated Meltano CLI and integrations are free software, not a hosted free ETL account. Operator pays for compute, storage, databases, schedulers, network, cloud services and any third-party connectors; individual plugin licenses and API quotas must be checked separately.
